Thanks for the forward — quick plan and owners from my side: 

- Week 0 (prep, pre-kickoff): Sarah (infra eng) snapshots sandbox + access guides; Priyom & I will draft lab exercises
- Week 1 (kickoff & arch/security): Laura (lead), 2 hours, include SOC 2 evidence walkthrough and logging retention options
- Week 2 (runtime ops): Ops lead (TBD) 3 hours; include dashboards, tracing hooks and fallback policy examples
- Week 3 (joint QA): small pilot with 1 customer scenario; measure latency and cost delta pre/post cache settings
- Week 4 (quality & evals): 2 hours, training on eval harness and regression alerting

Metrics to track (agreed with Vanessa): time-to-first-successful-call, average p95 latency, tokens per successful request, number of rollouts completed without rollback.

I'll attach a shortops note with required artifacts — ops_playback_notes.txt. Priyom, please confirm you can take the lab content and the hands-on facilitation. Once we lock the kickoff I'll update the MAP spreadsheet.
